chapter: Emmett Hardy, Bix and the Rhythm Kings
title: Hardy's death from periodontitis
summary: Hardy dies weeks after surgery and Hazel says the certificate named periodontitis rather than TB.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues

blocks.x: He beat that. And he came home.

And about a month, a month or six weeks later, parodonitis set in and killed him. And that's, that's actually what killed him. I mean, that's, that's what the, the death certificate said, parodonitis, not, not TB.
